title: A field guide to good taste
subtitle: A concise collection of practical notes, experiments, and ideas for people building what comes next.

readingPage.title: A field guide to good taste

cards.title: Start with attention
cards.paragraph: Good taste begins with noticing. Look closely at the details you return to and the choices that make an experience feel clear.

cards.title: Make room for a point of view
cards.paragraph: A strong point of view is the confidence to choose what matters, remove what distracts, and let useful details speak.

cards.title: Follow the small details
cards.paragraph: Materials, rhythm, language, and spacing shape how something feels. Small decisions become meaningful when they support the same idea.

cards.title: Try, notice, refine
cards.paragraph: Treat each draft as an experiment. Make a thoughtful change, notice what improves, and keep refining until it feels simple and alive.
